title: Kotlin Scope Functions
description: A practical guide to Kotlin let, run, with, apply, and also scope functions.

tutorials.title: let Block
tutorials.description: Use let to transform a value and work with its result in a scoped block.

tutorials.title: run Block
tutorials.description: Use run to execute a block with the receiver available as this.

tutorials.title: with Block
tutorials.description: Use with to configure or operate on an object within a focused scope.

tutorials.title: apply Block
tutorials.description: Use apply to configure an object and return that same object.

tutorials.title: also Block
tutorials.description: Use also to perform side effects while returning the original object.
